name: 97217 · Portland, OR
findings: ZIP 97217 (Portland) has 172 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97217 (Portland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97217 (Portland) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 61 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
